**Current**
- Josh sees him as a 1 USD player in auctions. He went for 4 USD in a mock auction, which Josh calls too much. (verdict, 2026-10-05; [10-05](https://youtu.be/Q6YlQDvD-aY?t=3187))
- Experts agree his usage will be capped this season because Trae Young and Anthony Davis will get the preferred touches. His very high summer league usage will not carry over. (verdict, 2026-09-22; [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1036), [09-19](https://youtu.be/uarqbNA2dFk?t=1141), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=1879), [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1921), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1258), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1271), [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1270), [07-23](https://youtu.be/LUTYUdXBG1M?t=119), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=339), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=355), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=797), [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=112))
- Do not draft him in the top 100 in category leagues. A Yahoo ADP around 76 to 77 is far too high. Josh calls him fine around 120, and other experts project him outside the top 100, as low as 180th in categories. (verdict, 2026-09-22; [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1036), [09-19](https://youtu.be/uarqbNA2dFk?t=1141), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=1879), [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1921), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1258), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1401), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=477))
- One expert is about 80% sure Washington keeps Anthony Davis but cannot rule out a trade, which would change the usage picture around Dybantsa. (verdict, 2026-09-14; [09-14](https://youtu.be/LM0cRCGoAUQ?t=1083))
- Rookie and the number one overall pick. Washington is building around him as its centerpiece. (fact, 2026-07-23; [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=129))
- Projected to start at small forward next to Trae Young, Kyshawn George, Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr. He may also play shooting guard or power forward depending on the lineup. (fact, 2026-07-23; [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=382), [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=379))
- Washington may bring him along slowly, with around 28 minutes a night early on instead of 34 or more. (verdict, 2026-07-23; [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=2052))
- Washington is trying to compete for the play-in, with around 40 wins projected, so late-season resting and minutes cuts are not expected. (verdict, 2026-07-23; [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=2185), [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1802), [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=112))

**Durable**
- Turnovers are his weakest category for a forward. Points are his only clear plus. (fact, 2026-10-05; stats)
- Has not historically been a good three-point or free throw shooter, and three-point volume is low. He went 1 for 11 from three and shot 39% from the field in summer league. (fact, 2026-09-22; [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1860), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1250), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1070), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=386), [07-23](https://youtu.be/LUTYUdXBG1M?t=78), [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1983))
- Experts call his steals and blocks poor. He had 5 steals and 3 blocks in two summer league games, which is not usual for him. If that holds, his category value rises. (verdict, 2026-09-10; [09-10](https://youtu.be/dlo7L8Ru91A?t=1921), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1250), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1070), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=386), [07-23](https://youtu.be/LUTYUdXBG1M?t=119), [08-02](https://youtu.be/TOn-D1SV7a8?t=1424))
- Volume scorer who gets to the rim and the free throw line at will. He drew about 7 free throws per game in summer league, as he did at BYU, and shot 89% at the rim. (fact, 2026-09-03; [08-02](https://youtu.be/TOn-D1SV7a8?t=1424), [07-23](https://youtu.be/LUTYUdXBG1M?t=78), [07-23](https://youtu.be/UTE0dNIv8nY?t=1983), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1250), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=386))
- Experts disagree on his passing. Some call his ball skills, passing and pick and roll play above average for his size, others call his passing unclear or not strong. (verdict, 2026-09-03; [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1070), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1458), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=386), [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=1489), [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1250))
- Has the worst category league profile of the top four rookies. Rebounds are fine but not high, and he is clearly better in points leagues. (verdict, 2026-09-03; [09-03](https://youtu.be/OBwWCxG9SqM?t=1250), [08-19](https://youtu.be/J1Eg3uaAICU?t=1401), [06-25](https://youtu.be/lOshTzDA4SA?t=386), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1070))
- Experts flag concerns about his shot selection and his defense. (verdict, 2026-06-23; [06-23](https://youtu.be/-rgXhs5BHiw?t=1489), [06-22](https://youtu.be/HxQjagSTTAM?t=205))

**Tags**
- Current: `rookie` (No. 1 overall pick), `usage competition` (Trae Young and Anthony Davis get preferred touches), `minutes limit` (May play around 28 minutes early as the team brings him along slowly), `bust candidate` (Yahoo ADP 76 to 77 and mock auction price of 4 USD are too high), `low shutdown risk` (Washington is chasing the play-in), `deep rotation` (10 or 11 man rotation with many wings)
- Durable: `points league player` (Scores and gets to the line, weak elsewhere in categories), `punt TO fit` (About 2.3 turnovers projected)

**Note.** Market prices of 3.4 to 6 USD and ranks of 85 to 92 sit near the edge of our 144-player pool, but the experts put him outside the top 100 in categories and Josh calls him a 1 USD player. Treat him as a 1 or 2 USD flyer at most. He fits best on a punt TO build, since points are his only clear plus. Early in the season, check his minutes (28 or 34-plus), how much usage he gets next to Young and Davis, and whether his summer league steals and blocks hold up.
